description: Only (T,rho) inputs so far (the EOS natural variables). Add a robust density solver (bracket+Newton on p(T,rho)) for (T,p), then (p,h)/(p,s), matching CoolProp's PropsSI input pairs. Handle multiple roots (liquid/vapor) + phase determination.

description: The outer coupling loop (multi_region::outer_iteration::MultiPhysicsSolver) plumbs meshDisp through the coupling but does not move mesh points — upstream multiPhysicsSolver::deformMesh calls movePoints. Needs mutable mesh-point geometry on outram_foam_basic_lib::FvMesh (points + geometry recompute), which basic-lib does not yet expose.
title: genfoam multiRegion: deformMesh / movePoints (apply meshDisp to mesh points)
